The current head is 25f130bde91cd644eef3e55ce1e74c62b8270740. The previous full CI run completed 195 jobs successfully but exposed a Raw-button lookup failure in the real-Gateway config test. A Linux reproduction showed the page connected and fully loaded with the button present. Two deterministic Chromium regressions then proved that tooltip adaptation could replace a button's accessible name during a transparent animation frame and retain the wrong name after reveal. The shared owner now separates accessible-name text from visual tooltip redundancy; no config-test assertion or timeout changed.

The repair passes 98 tooltip/config tests, a final two-case Chromium rerun, and the unchanged three-case real-Gateway auth/config suite against the rebuilt candidate. The full changed-file gate and coupled runtime/UI build now pass on the current commit; fresh Codex review found no actionable P0 issue. The bounded repair adds six production lines. The existing Goal video and screenshots remain accurately labeled with their recorded commit, e813a8d5fd9e; Goal behavior is unchanged by this repair.

The latest review's base/history limitation was specific to its detached environment; the lead verified the full repository and prior mechanical rebase with range-diff. For the ACPX rank-up request, the matching candidate npm tarball was installed in disposable managed storage and loaded through the canonical registry, real hook runner, and Goal admission guard. Its emitted entry matches the tarball, local-agent admission is allowed, and ACP/unspecified contexts remain guarded. This is candidate-artifact proof, not a published or full packaged-host upgrade claim. Published-install validation is deferred to release because publication is not part of this request; the existing release workflow requires all publishable official plugins and waits for plugin npm publication before publishing core. The source-checkout doctor removed the managed duplicate during attempted full startup, so that path was not bypassed. These limits are recorded in the PR body.

[Current-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/33162346315) is still running. The maintainer protocol/persistence decision remains recorded above; no new protocol version, configuration option, or storage change is added by this follow-up.
